title.en: Submit a Morpho Vault V2 adapter cap increase (curator)
title.zh-TW: 提交 Morpho Vault V2 轉接合約上限的提高（curator）

summary.en: As curator, the Safe calls the vault's `multicall` with two `submit` calls inside: one queues raising the absolute cap of the vault's market adapter to the amount you type, the other raising its relative cap to the percentage you type. The adapter cap limits everything the vault puts into Morpho Blue markets through that adapter. This transaction only queues; once the vault's timelock has passed, anyone can execute it. It moves none of the Safe's assets.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 以 curator 身分呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`，裡面兩個 `submit`：一個排隊把 vault 的市場轉接合約的絕對上限提高到你填的數量，一個把相對上限提高到你填的百分比。轉接合約上限管住 vault 經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場的全部。這筆交易只排隊；等 vault 的 timelock 過了，任何人都能執行。不動 Safe 的任何資產。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets how much each market can hold (its cap), and the allocator moves funds within the caps. Raising a cap takes a `submit` first, and it can run only after the timelock has passed.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場能放多少（上限），allocator 在上限內搬錢。提高上限要先 `submit`，等 timelock 過了才能執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 10 audits (Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and one contest).
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 10 份稽核（Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽）。

text.en: Raising a cap is queued, and executing it needs no signature: once the timelock ends, anyone can call `increaseAbsoluteCap` and `increaseRelativeCap` to make it take effect. The contract checks only `executableAt`, not who calls. What really needs your judgment is this `submit`.
text.zh-TW: 提高上限要排隊，執行不用簽：timelock 到期後任何人都能呼叫 `increaseAbsoluteCap` 和 `increaseRelativeCap` 讓它生效，合約只檢查 `executableAt`，不檢查是誰。真正要你判斷的是這筆 `submit`。

recommendation.en: Before signing, confirm the vault and both caps. After it is sent, you can still cancel it with `revoke` within the timelock.
recommendation.zh-TW: 簽之前確認 vault 和兩個上限；送出後在 timelock 內還能用 `revoke` 取消。

text.en: This template accepts only the vault's own registry `adapter`, with one `submit` each for the absolute and the relative cap, the shape established curators sent (7 such transactions in the recent history of 265 curator Safes). A cap for another adapter, or several ids in one transaction, gets MISMATCH from verify.
text.zh-TW: 這個模板只收 vault 登錄的 `adapter`，絕對和相對上限各一個 `submit`，這是成熟 curator 送的寫法（265 個 curator Safe 近期的交易裡 7 筆）。別的轉接合約、或一筆排好幾個 id，verify 會判 MISMATCH。

recommendation.en: Put one id in each transaction. On MISMATCH, do not sign.
recommendation.zh-TW: 一筆只放一個 id；判 MISMATCH 就不要簽。

role.en: The vault's asset; the absolute cap is counted in it
role.zh-TW: vault 的資產，絕對上限用它計算

role.en: The factory that creates Vault V2 market adapters. It answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true: it created the adapter
role.zh-TW: 建立 Vault V2 市場轉接合約的工廠，它回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，轉接合約是它建立的

1.multicall.data.en: The two calls the vault runs in order, fixed at two items: queue the absolute cap first, then the relative cap. If either fails, the whole transaction fails.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 依序執行的兩個呼叫，固定兩項：先排絕對上限，再排相對上限。任一個失敗，整筆失敗。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: queue an absolute cap increase.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：排隊提高絕對上限。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.en: The full call to queue, listed item by item below. The vault records its `executableAt`; only after that time can this exact call run.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.zh-TW: 要排隊的完整呼叫，下面逐項列出。vault 記下它的 `executableAt`，到期才能執行這一模一樣的呼叫。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "the whole adapter".
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「整個轉接合約」。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The kind of id, fixed to this: a cap on everything the vault puts through this adapter, not on one market or one collateral token.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this：vault 經由這個轉接合約放出去的全部，不是單一市場或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets; its registry `adapter`.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場；就是登錄的 `adapter`。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The new absolute cap: the most assets the vault can put into the adapter. Typing `max` means no absolute cap, relying only on the relative cap.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 新的絕對上限：vault 最多放多少資產進轉接合約。打 `max` 等於不設絕對上限，只靠相對上限。

1.multicall.data[1].en: Item 2: queue a relative cap increase.
1.multicall.data[1].zh-TW: 第二項：排隊提高相對上限。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.en: The full call to queue, listed item by item below.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.zh-TW: 要排隊的完整呼叫，下面逐項列出。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The same cap id as item 1.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 跟第一項同一個上限 id。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The kind of id, fixed to this: a cap on everything the vault puts through this adapter, not on one market or one collateral token.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this：vault 經由這個轉接合約放出去的全部，不是單一市場或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets; its registry `adapter`.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場；就是登錄的 `adapter`。

1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.en: The new relative cap: the largest share of the vault's total assets the adapter can hold, where 100% equals 10^18.
1.multicall.data[1].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 新的相對上限：轉接合約最多占 vault 總資產的比例，100% 等於 10^18。
